analysis.title: Europe Healthcare: Biotechnology - Previewing 3Q26 for commercial SMID caps
key_insights: Autolus (Buy, PT $6.00 from $5.80): focus on Aucatzyl revenue against upgraded FY26 guidance of $140-150mn (prior $120-135mn). 2Q26 sales were $45.7mn, up 118% YoY and 74% QoQ.
Autolus gross margin was 55% in 2Q26. Management targets 65%-70% for the adult ALL business within 12 to 18 months. GS forecasts FY26 margin of 49% vs Visible Alpha consensus of 47%.

Autolus has 82 activated US treatment centers and targets more than 90 by year-end. UK launched Jan 2026, and investors want updates on NHS routine commissioning. No EU sales are expected in 2026 given reimbursement challenges.

Autolus 3Q26: GS Aucatzyl revenue estimate of $38.3mn is in line with consensus. GS net loss of $36.9mn is 22% below consensus of $47.5mn, driven by lower COGS and SG&A. Cash of $203.1mn at Jun 30, 2026 funds operations into 2Q28.
BioArctic (Neutral, PT SEK345 unchanged): partner Biogen reports 3Q26 on Oct 28. GS forecasts US Leqembi sales of $110mn, 2% above consensus of $108mn, and global sales of $199mn vs $198mn consensus.

Subcutaneous initiation dosing of Leqembi was FDA approved on July 13 and is seen as the key driver of broader uptake. SC maintenance has been available in the US since Oct 2025. IQVIA data show both Leqembi and Lilly's Kisunla growing, suggesting the total market is expanding.

GS expects Eisai FY26 (2Q26-1Q27) Leqembi sales of $892mn, 5% below Eisai's guidance of about $938mn but 9% above Visible Alpha consensus. UK commercial discussions between Eisai and the government are ongoing with no timeline.

BioArctic reports 3Q26 on Nov 25. GS royalty estimate of SEK192mn is 2% below consensus of SEK197mn. GS is cautious on any efficacy signal from the exidavnemab Phase 2a EXIST readout given prior failures in the space.

Immunocore (Buy, PT $74 unchanged): reports 3Q26 on Nov 6. GS forecasts Kimmtrak revenue of $109mn, 3% below consensus of $112mn, because of possible US stocking last quarter. Management guides to modest Kimmtrak growth.

Immunocore GS 3Q26 operating expense estimate of $125mn is 3% above consensus of $121mn. Phase 3 TEBE-AM readout in cutaneous melanoma is possible by year-end (event driven) after recruitment completed in September.

Immunocore model update raises FY26/FY27 Kimmtrak sales 2%/1% on IQVIA data and cuts FY26/FY27 net loss estimates 25%/2%. PT blends a DCF of $62 (70% weight) and an M&A valuation of $103 (30% weight).

Valneva (Sell, PT raised to EUR2.20/$5.10 from EUR2.15/$5.00): focus is the FDA path for Lyme vaccine LB6V after EMA validation in Aug 2026, FY26 guidance, and the 2027 goal of financial self-sustainability.

Pfizer intends to file for US approval of LB6V in 2H26/1H27 despite the VALOR Phase 3 missing the first pre-specified statistical criterion because of lower-than-expected event rates. The trial met the second criterion.

Valneva and Pfizer see a Lyme vaccine market above $1bn vs GS at about EUR450mn. GS and consensus model 2027 VLA15 royalties of EUR8.2mn and EUR11.5mn respectively, and GS forecasts peak risk-adjusted royalties of EUR32mn.
Valneva Shigella Phase 2 readouts slipped from mid-year to 3Q26 and then to 4Q26. GS models peak risk-unadjusted sales of $220mn at 25% probability of success.

Valneva 3Q26: GS revenue of EUR37mn is 2% below consensus of EUR38mn and operating expenses of EUR52mn are 8% above EUR48mn. GS EBIT of -EUR12mn compares with consensus of -EUR6mn. Net income of -EUR17mn is in line.

Valneva held EUR122mn cash at Jun 30, 2026 and 1H26 operating cash burn was EUR13.7mn. GS forecasts FY26 operating cash flow of -EUR33mn. Up to $243mn of VLA15 milestones are due from Pfizer, plus tiered royalties of 14-22%.
Valneva FY26 guidance is product sales EUR135-150mn and total revenue EUR145-160mn. GS estimates EUR139mn and EUR145mn, below the midpoints of EUR143mn and EUR153mn.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised from $5.80 after rolling the DCF forward three months and updating 2Q26 balance sheet and cash flow. Valuation uses a 13% WACC and 0% terminal growth.
BioArctic PT unchanged. Minor EPS changes across 2026-2036 from prescription trends, financial items and FX. DCF uses a 10% WACC and 2% terminal growth.
PT unchanged, blending a $62 DCF (70%) and a $103 M&A value (30%). Kimmtrak estimates were raised on IQVIA data.
PT moves up about 2% from $5.00 (EUR2.20 from EUR2.15) after EUR/USD and financing updates and a three-month DCF roll-forward. Sell is kept on Lyme uncertainty and thin pipeline optionality.

sector_views.rationale: Ratings are mixed: Buy on Autolus and Immunocore, Neutral on BioArctic, Sell on Valneva. Focus is on launch momentum, margins and regulatory progress.

earnings_insights: Autolus 3Q26 report due Nov 10: GS estimate Aucatzyl revenue $38.3mn vs Visible Alpha consensus estimate $38.0mn to $38.5mn (in line). GS estimate net loss $36.9mn vs consensus estimate $47.5mn. GS estimate COGS $16.0mn and OpEx $61.0mn vs consensus estimates $17.6mn and $66.9mn.

Autolus 2Q26 reported Aucatzyl sales of $45.7mn (reported 2Q26), up 118% from $20.9mn in 2Q25. Gross margin 55% in 2Q26. FY26 guidance raised to $140-150mn from $120-135mn. YTD sales of $71.9mn are 50% of the guidance midpoint.

BioArctic 3Q26 report due Nov 25: GS estimate royalties SEK192mn vs consensus estimate SEK197mn. GS estimate total revenue SEK301mn vs consensus estimate SEK306mn. GS estimate EBIT SEK18mn vs consensus estimate SEK18mn. GS estimate EPS SEK0.26 vs consensus estimate SEK0.24.
Biogen reports 3Q26 on Oct 28. GS estimate US Leqembi sales $110mn vs consensus estimate $108mn. GS estimate global Leqembi sales $199mn vs consensus estimate $198mn.

BioArctic FY26 royalties: GS estimate SEK862mn vs company guide SEK880mn and consensus estimate SEK872mn. Leqembi FY26 sales vs Biogen consensus: GS estimate $892mn vs guidance $938mn and consensus $817mn.
Immunocore 3Q26 report due Nov 6: GS estimate Kimmtrak revenue $109mn vs consensus estimate $112mn. GS estimate operating expenses $125mn vs consensus estimate $121mn.

Valneva 3Q26 estimates (EUR): GS revenue 37mn vs consensus estimate 38mn. GS OpEx 52mn vs 48mn. GS EBIT -12mn vs -6mn. GS net loss -17mn vs -17mn. GS EPS -0.09 vs consensus -0.07. GS Ixchiq revenue 1.9mn vs consensus 1.6mn, and FY26 Ixchiq 8.2mn vs 8.4mn.

Valneva FY26 vs guidance: GS product sales EUR139mn (guidance EUR135-150mn, midpoint EUR143mn), consensus EUR137mn. GS total revenue EUR145mn (guidance EUR145-160mn), consensus EUR146mn. GS implied YoY revenue decline of 13%.
risk_factors: Autolus: negative trial outcomes, weaker Aucatzyl sales from logistics, manufacturing or real-world profile issues, regulatory delays, and higher cash burn.
BioArctic: weaker Leqembi commercial performance, clinical failure of exidavnemab or Leqembi trials, and higher cash burn.
Immunocore: negative clinical data for Kimmtrak and IMC-F106-C, better competitor data in melanoma, trial delays, and slower Kimmtrak uptake. A $6mn US channel inventory unwind is also a factor.

Valneva: uncertain Lyme approval and commercial size, Ixchiq headwinds including UK license revocation and US suspension, rising cash burn, and delayed Shigella readouts. Upside risks to a Sell are stronger Lyme or Ixchiq uptake and faster timelines.

tension_points.bull_case: Pfizer plans to file in the US in 2H26/1H27, citing clinically meaningful efficacy and the second pre-specified criterion being met. Valneva and Pfizer see a market above $1bn.
tension_points.bear_case: VALOR missed the first pre-specified statistical criterion. GS sees a market of about EUR450mn, with uncertain approval and no other pipeline optionality.
tension_points.what_invalidates: FDA acceptance and approval of the LB6V BLA, along with an ACIP recommendation, would challenge the Sell case.
